sample.selection: Three safe6 newly preprocessed, identity-confirmed PROD IDs: 4112, 4344, 586.
sample.selection_bias: All three selected owners are Japanese professionals; this is deliberate for clean ID and official-profile verification but underrepresents Chinese/Korean source complexity and likely makes the estimate optimistic for a mixed-origin batch.

verified_name_row_check.result: IDs 4112 and 4344 had no catalog.names rows; ID 586 had five legacy rows, all status=review and verified_at=null. Therefore zero existing verified rows for all three IDs.

timer.timing_note: Tool latency is measured around web/exec calls. The residual is wall time minus measured tool time; it includes reading, source comparison, normalization decisions, and orchestration. It is not keystroke-only typing time.
